value.name: set up probate inventory
value.description: Asha begins the estate inventory at a makeshift probate station with Daniel, Lucia, and Rosa present.
evidence: （The dining room table has been turned into a temporary probate station: legal pads, estate ledgers, tea gone cold, and a ring of keys. Asha begins the estate inventory with Daniel, Lucia, and Rosa all present.）
Asha: Let's proceed with the inventory

value.name: warn about missing codicil
value.description: Asha warns that the missing codicil must be addressed before any decisions are made.
evidence: Asha: Let's proceed with the inventory, but I want to emphasize that addressing the missing codicil is crucial; without clarity on that front, any decisions we make could haunt you all in the future.

value.name: dismiss codicil concern
value.description: Daniel rejects the codicil issue as a rumor and insists on focusing on selling the house.
evidence: Daniel: We can’t afford to get bogged down by what might just be a rumor; we need to focus on selling the house and moving forward, not chasing shadows.

value.name: urge uncovering truth
value.description: Asha argues that ignoring the codicil could jeopardize everything and that the truth must be found first.
evidence: Asha: I understand your urgency, Daniel, but ignoring the possibility of the codicil could lead to complications that may jeopardize everything you've worked for; we must uncover the truth before making any final decisions.

value.name: invoke mother's legacy
value.description: Lucia challenges Daniel by framing the issue as preserving their mother's legacy and wishes.
evidence: Lucia: "Daniel, this isn't just about selling the house; it's about preserving Mom's legacy and understanding her wishes—can’t you see that?"

value.name: support codicil investigation
value.description: Rosa backs Lucia and insists the truth should be uncovered before any decision is made.
evidence: Rosa: "Lucia's right, Daniel; this isn't just about bricks and mortar—it's about honoring the heart of our family, and the truth deserves to be uncovered before we decide anything."

value.name: agree to investigate witness
value.description: Asha proposes meeting the witness who remembered the codicil so the family can gather all the facts.
evidence: Asha: Absolutely, Rosa; we owe it to your mother and to each other to explore this thoroughly. Let's arrange a meeting with the witness who recalled the codicil—it’s essential we gather all the facts before moving forward.

value.name: reject investigation as wasteful
value.description: Daniel again resists the inquiry, calling it a wild goose chase and insisting on decisive action to sell the house.
